evals.name: Detect and fix stdout print() corruption in a FastMCP stdio tool
evals.prompt: Audit our FastMCP server in `server.py` where `search_docs` prints debug logs to stdout, and fix it so stdio JSON-RPC framing is not corrupted.

assertions.description: Agent executed the deterministic AST MCP auditor script.
Diagnostics were redirected to stderr or logging instead of bare stdout print().

evals.name: Enforce explicit type hints and docstring on @mcp.tool handlers
evals.prompt: Add a `@mcp.tool()` handler `query_metrics(service, window_minutes)` to our MCP server with strict schema validation.

assertions.description: Tool function includes explicit parameter and return type annotations.

evals.name: Prevent 0.0.0.0 network exposure on MCP SSE transport
evals.prompt: Review the FastMCP SSE server launcher and fix any unsafe network host binding.

assertions.description: Server binds exclusively to 127.0.0.1 or localhost.
